# FOAMGLAS

> FOAMGLAS® by Owens Corning manufactures premium cellular glass thermal insulation solutions for building and industrial applications worldwide.

FOAMGLAS® is a leading provider of foam glass insulation products used in roof insulation, waterproofing, fire protection, and industrial applications. The company operates across multiple European and international markets with localized regional support.
